sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 9 (check 8) and Internal Quality Checks row 9 (no annotation cells populated for this check); Deterministic Checks rows check-task-name.py and check-task-slug.sh
evidence: Static identity check; no runtime measurement is needed for this row and none is claimed. (1) Name vs slug: task.toml:5 name = "turing/colderwater-playground-devtools"; manifest.json task = "projects/colderwater-playground-devtools" (the snapshot dir named 'task' is declared not an identity defect); frozen task.toml sha256 6d547769... equals both the manifest entry and the live projects/colderwater-playground-devtools/task.toml, so name == turing/<dirname>, org turing, slug has 3 hyphen tokens. (2) Description, task.toml:6 "A browser code playground with a custom editor, formatting, multiple carets, isolated preview and saved revisions." names this product and its real axes: overview.md:3-5 (editor, preview, console, shared library, revision history; formatting, selection, multiple carets, undo; preview separate from editing surface), behaviour.md:3 (fresh isolated preview document), behaviour.md:9-13 (save, stale-save conflict, history restore), ui.md:3 (own DOM/canvas/SVG editor, no textarea/CodeMirror/Monaco). The 40 functional criterion ids (cw_multi_caret_*, cw_*_format_semantics_and_undo, cw_preview_isolation, cw_stale_save_refused, cw_history_restore_retry ...) map onto the same axes. (3) Keywords task.toml:7 keep the template's webdev/turing/full-stack and add custom-editor, javascript, html, formatting, code-playground, devtools, all true of the product (instruction.md:1 'JavaScript and complete HTML files'; console panel in app_context.md:6). (4) Metadata task.toml:10-15: difficulty 'hard' and category 'programming' are allowed contract values; difficulty_explanation names custom editor selection, multi-caret undo, formatting, isolated execution and revision-safe saving, matching the notes and criteria; tags equal the template's; provenance 'Adapted from the supplied Colderwater playground task.' and arena_slice 'custom-code-editor-formatting-preview-history' describe the same task. No quoted criterion counts appear in description/provenance, so there is nothing to drift against the actual 3 gate / 40 functional / 6 polish / 3 visual blocks. (5) Product name is consistent everywhere: app_context.md:3 'Name: Colderwater playground', line 1 of all five judge prompts 'the live Colderwater playground', solution package.json:2 'colderwater-playground-devtools', server.js:12 service 'colderwater-playground'. A case-insensitive search of the task for 'coldwater', 'patchpad', 'gridforge' found no leftover sibling-task identity; no CHANGE_ME placeholder remains. Counterexample probes: a mis-copied sibling name or stale description would show as a mismatch between task.toml and app_context/prompts - none found; a conforming submission is unaffected by these strings because the brief does not mandate a brand name and no criterion requires the word 'Colderwater' to be rendered by the app (prompts only use it to refer to the app under test). Observations that are not defects: the QC run id spells 'coldwater' while the slug is 'colderwater' (run label only, outside the task); the contract's template comment suggests the description may also mention judge and dimension policy, but check 8's Verify line only requires product and actual axes, and omitting counts/policy avoids drift.
